top_choice_rationale: Base editing is the clearest attributable chemical invention on the slate: a deaminase tethered to a Cas9 nickase converts one base in place without double-strand cleavage, and the adenine editor required an evolved TadA acting on DNA, a new reaction. The 2020 prize honoured guided cleavage, so a citation worded around deamination is a distinct achievement. Liu, Komor and Gaudelli follow the sequence of the work, results are reproduced and first clinical use exists. Residual risks are the short record and the Kondo/Nishida Target-AID priority question.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Xiaodong Zou is a Stockholm University colleague, but no tie to any credited laureate
